Monopile foundations will be installed using a dynamically positioned crane vessel and/or a jack-up style installation vessel equipped with a hydraulic impact hammer to drive the monopiles into the seabed.
Monopile foundation installation procedures include verifying foundation location, removing any obstructions, and leveling the site if required.
The installation vessel positions itself at the foundation location, including jacking and preloading as required. Anchors may be used in some instances.
Monopile verticality is verified, and the pile is allowed to penetrate the seabed under its own weight.
Noise mitigation procedures are implemented during monopile installation.
Pile driving is conducted using as low impact energy as possible, not exceeding 4,400 kilojoules (kJ).
